provenance.section: Ticker — top-of-book fields best_bid, best_ask, best_bid_quantity, best_ask_quantity
modifications: All four best_* values changed, modelling a match that did move the top of book.

best_bid_quantity is spelled "1.50" and best_ask_quantity "2" — the venue types these as unconstrained strings and documents no canonical spelling, so the adapter's canonicalization is exercised here too.

expectation: Parses. Produces one ReferenceTopOfBookChanged with bidPrice 21932.5, bidSize 1.5, askPrice 21934.1, askSize 2 — all canonical decimal strings, none of them ever a JavaScript number.
